title: Freestyle page when a Figma kit silhouette already maps to a cite
cues: Wireframe→Build invents accordion stacks, card walls, or novel chrome while knowledge/kits/figma-library-map.json already names a preferCite for the job
ban: Do not bypass the brand-agnostic kit map. Lock the brief to preferCite and open the matching figma-kit-silhouettes example before painting.
remediation: Open knowledge/kits/figma-library-map.json → silhouetteMap for the job → set data-cite to preferCite → copy regions from corpus/blueprints/figma-kit-silhouettes/ → re-measure. Structure from kits; paint from house shadcn.
examples: Decide job built as KPI accordion landfill instead of shadcn-operate-decide worklist
Form built as card-per-field gallery instead of SDS field stack → shadcn-form
App shell with marketing hero instead of shadcn-sidebar-07 + one primary
